system.description:
When you try to spot something out of place in a social interaction or someone's personal space, answer the following questions, and roll the dice.

  • Have you been intimate with them recently?

  • Are you free of other distractions?

success.value:
Ask two questions from the following list.

  • How does your character feel about __________?

  • What are you planning?

  • How could I get your character to __________?

  • What do you have of value or use?

  • What do you hope to get from __________?

partial.value:
Ask two questions from the following list. Your target also asks you a question.

  • How does your character feel about __________?

  • What are you planning?

  • How could I get your character to __________?

  • What do you have of value or use?

  • What do you hope to get from __________?
